s.note: the paperwork side of the precinct
s.how: Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread each half with 250g cream cheese between them and top with 200g smoked salmon, thin red onion and capers.

s.note: Terry wants to be a peacock, so let him fly
s.how: Mix 150g chickpea flour, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli, salt and 180ml water into a batter. Stir in 2 sliced onions and 100g chopped spinach. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 4 minutes and serve with 200g yoghurt mixed with mint.

m.note: late nights on the case in New York
m.how: Coat 600g diced pork in cornflour and fry until crisp. Fry 1 capsicum and 1 onion, add 200ml pineapple juice, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp vinegar and 2 tbsp sugar, then toss the pork through. Serve with 300g rice fried with 2 eggs and peas.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C for 28 minutes and cool before cutting.

d.note: the cop bar the precinct drinks at
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager. Pour into schooner glasses and serve with a bowl of salted peanuts. Soda water and lime for anyone driving. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
